title: Evidence:Investigation One indictments against Josh Saunders and Brandon Henderson Sr.

data.claim: The August 21 Ohio Attorney General-origin announcement states that Josh Saunders was indicted on three F1 rape counts and one F3 gross-sexual-imposition count, and Brandon Henderson Sr. was indicted on 21 counts comprising child endangering, gross sexual imposition, and sexual battery at the published felony/misdemeanor grades.
data.notes: Protected-minor identities and all re-identifying details are excluded. No victim person records are created.
